_meta.why_no_replicas: Single-node cluster. A replica can never be assigned, so every index sat yellow with an unassigned shard - 481 of them by 2026-09-02, doubling shard count for nothing.
_meta.why_keyword: service/category/origin/log_level are filtered and aggregated on, never full-text searched. keyword skips the analyzer and keeps the doc_values that make Kibana's filters fast.
